raw_meta_yaml:
# Keep external source revisions in sync with upstream cmake/dependencies.cmake.
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: CoolProp
  version: "8.0.0"
  sha256: 026593c69ce8c9c014d9eac4d07d0b5c9058442742399562b6cdd6ce322f7f89

package:
  name: coolprop
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  - url: https://github.com/CoolProp/${{ name }}/archive/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
    sha256: ${{ sha256 }}
    patches:
      - conda-dependencies.patch
  # External dependencies
  # These headers are not available as conda packages on every target platform.
  - url: https://github.com/CoolProp/IF97/archive/7aaced024a702f0985474bf293cdaae9c8d06521.tar.gz
    sha256: f62207a854293b1814f2619477d71e17ffaf04cf448c2bd79d173336eb4d36f6
    target_directory: externals/IF97
  - url: https://github.com/CoolProp/REFPROP-headers/archive/b4faab1b73911c32c4b69c526c7e92f74edb67de.zip
    sha256: a98351b3618e0f9f5dc95da219feaf55d029b5f5b961fdfb8262ad3e7e6e89a7
    target_directory: externals/REFPROP-headers
  - url: https://github.com/tristanpenman/valijson/archive/refs/tags/v1.0.6.tar.gz
    sha256: bf0839de19510ff7792d8a8aca94ea11a288775726b36c4c9a2662651870f8da
    target_directory: externals/valijson

build:
  # pypy is not passing and we don't want to support it
  number: 1
  skip: python_impl == 'pypy'

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != target_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ target_platform }}
        - cython >=3.1
        - nanobind ==2.12.0
        - scikit-build-core >=0.10
    - ${{ compiler('c') }}
    - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
    - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
    - cmake >=3.15
    - ninja
  host:
    - python
    - cython >=3.1
    - nanobind ==2.12.0
    - scikit-build-core >=0.10
    - pip
    - eigen >=5.0.1
    - fmt >=12.0.0
    - libboost-headers
    - msgpack-cxx
    - nlohmann_json >=3.12.0
  run:
    - python
    - numpy
    - matplotlib-base

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - CoolProp
        - CoolProp.State
        - CoolProp.tests
        - if: not match(python, ">=2,<3") or not linux
          then: CoolProp.Plots
        - CoolProp.GUI
      pip_check: false
  - script:
      - python -c "import CoolProp; assert CoolProp.__version__ == '${{ version }}'"
      - python -c "from CoolProp.CoolProp import PropsSI; assert abs(PropsSI('T', 'P', 101325, 'Q', 0, 'Water') - 373.1243) < 0.001"
      - python -c "from CoolProp.CoolProp import AbstractState, PT_INPUTS; s = AbstractState('HEOS', 'Water'); s.update(PT_INPUTS, 101325, 300); assert abs(s.rhomass() - 996.5569) < 0.001"
      - python -c "from CoolProp.CoolProp import HAPropsSI; assert 0 < HAPropsSI('W', 'T', 300, 'P', 101325, 'R', 0.5) < 0.1"

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Open-source thermodynamic and transport properties database
  description: |
